title: Werkstudent Recruiting (Fitness Trainer) (m/w/d)
description: Über LIFTED Mit LIFTED bauen wir die neue Go-to-Marke für Krafttraining auf. In einer Welt voller Longevity Quick Fixes und exklusiver Fitness-Trends konzentrieren wir uns auf einen der wichtigsten Faktoren für ein langes und gesundes Leben: Krafttraining. Unsere Studios machen Krafttraining einfach, effektiv und messbar – für Menschen, die stärker werden wollen, sich in klassischen Fitnessstudios aber nicht zuhause fühlen. Der Trainingsfortschritt wird digital erfasst, während unsere Trainer jedes Mitglied individuell unterstützen und für ein motivierendes Trainingserlebnis sorgen. Hinter LIFTED steht ein erfahrenes Founding Team mit tiefem Know-how in der Fitnessbranche & dem Aufbau von Offline Operations. Gemeinsam haben wir BEAT81 von Grund auf aufgebaut und auf 35 Standorte skaliert. Jetzt entwickeln wir Krafttraining mit LIFTED neu – und bauen die nächste große Fitnessmarke auf. In den vergangenen 18 Monaten haben wir 6 Studios in Berlin eröffnet. Bis Ende 2026 werden wir neun Standorte betreiben. Ab 2027 planen wir, jährlich mehr als 12 neue Studios in deutschen Großstädten zu eröffnen. Um dieses Konzept weiter auszubauen, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Recruiting (Fitness Trainer) (m/w/d). Über die Rolle Unsere TrainerInnen sind das Herz von LIFTED. Sie bringen unseren KundInnnen die Grundlagen des Krafttrainings bei, helfen ihnen dabei Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und bieten ein einzigartiges Trainingserlebnis. Und genau die Menschen, die das möglich machen, suchen wir. Als Werkstudent im Trainer Recruiting spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Wachstum von LIFTED. Du findest talentierte TrainerInnen, begeisterst sie für uns und begleitest sie vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Tryout im Studio. Mit jedem neuen Studio wächst unser Team – und du gestaltest aktiv mit, wer Teil davon wird. Aufgaben Active Sourcing Du findest passende Trainer:innen in ganz Deutschland über Instagram, LinkedIn und andere Kanäle , sprichst sie direkt an und machst sie neugierig auf LIFTED. Screening Du sichtest eingehende Bewerbungen, schätzt ein, wer zu uns passt , und hältst den Überblick über alle Kandidat:innen im Prozess. Erstgespräche Du führst die ersten Interviews , lernst die Kandidat:innen kennen und stellst LIFTED vor. Tryouts organisieren Bevor wir TrainerInnen einstellen, laden wir sie zu einem Tryout ins Studio ein. So lernen wir sie kennen und sehen sie in Action. Du planst diese Tryouts und koordinierst die Termine mit Kandidat:innen und Team. Prozesse mitgestalten Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir unser Recruiting weiterentwickeln können , z.B. durch sauberes Tracking. Dein Profil Du lebst in Berlin und hast Freude daran, Talente für unsere Vision zu begeistern. Folgende Voraussetzungen bringst du mit: Studium: Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise in BWL, Psychologie, Sportwissenschaften oder Ähnlichem. Kommunikation: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und fühlst dich auch in Gesprächen mit Fremden wohl. Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mind. C1-Niveau). Menschenkenntnis: Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wer ins Team passt. Organisation: Du behältst auch bei vielen Kandidat:innen gleichzeitig den Überblick. Eigeninitiative: Du packst an und erledigst Dinge, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss. Fitness-Affinität: Du hast Spaß an Sport – Erfahrung im Krafttraining ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Benefits Early Stage: Du bist früh dabei und gestaltest den Aufbau von LIFTED aktiv mit – eng mit einem Gründerteam, das bereits ein erfolgreiches Fitness-Unternehmen skaliert hat. Echte Verantwortung: Du übernimmst schnell eigene Aufgaben und siehst direkt, was du bewegst – jede:r Trainer, den/die du findest, steht bald in unseren Studios. Learn & Grow: Du lernst Recruiting von Grund auf und bekommst Einblick in den Aufbau eines Startups mit Offline-Produkt. Flexibilität: Deine Arbeitszeiten stimmen wir mit deinem Studium ab. Berlin HQ: Ein schöner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen des Prenzlauer Bergs (Senefelder Platz). Becoming Stronger: Eine kostenlose, unbegrenzte Mitgliedschaft für alle LIFTED Studios. Team Spirit: Regelmäßige Teamevents wie Padel, BBQs, Trainer Partys und mehr. Du willst lernen, wie man ein Team für ein schnell wachsendes Startup aufbaut? Dann ist das deine Chance: Wir sind ein hoch motiviertes Team mit einem schnell wachsenden, profitablen Geschäftsmodell und einer Mission mit echtem Purpose – Krafttraining für alle zugänglich zu machen. Wir schätzen deine Zeit genauso wie dein Talent . Deshalb kannst du auf ein klassisches Anschreiben verzichten. Schick uns einfach deinen CV und eine kurze Notiz (3–5 Sätze) , in der du dein relevantestes Achievement beschreibst. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Working Student / Werkstudent — Applied AI - Software Engineering
raw.description:
The Role

You’ll help build real products across the software lifecycle: understand the problem → design → implement → release → improve. You’ll take ownership of well-defined tasks and features, with guidance, code reviews, and feedback from experienced engineers.

You’ll work closely with engineering, product, and design, and join customer conversations to understand requirements and share progress. We value curiosity, systems thinking, and a practical approach to turning ideas into working software.

You don’t need to know our entire stack. Bring solid foundations, some hands-on experience, and the motivation to learn by building.

What You’ll Do

  • Build with AI: use generative tools, work with our reusable components, and help test and evaluate AI-powered features.
  • Contribute to engineering decisions: explore solutions, discuss trade-offs with the team, and implement practical approaches.
  • Ship useful features: work with product and design to turn requirements into manageable tasks and working software.
  • Work across the stack: contribute to services, APIs, data pipelines, and frontends, depending on your strengths and the project.
  • Build with quality in mind: write maintainable code, test your changes, and help improve reliability and performance with support from the team.
  • Collaborate with clients: join discussions, help clarify requirements, demo your work, and incorporate feedback alongside experienced teammates.
  • Communicate clearly: document your work, ask questions early, and keep the team informed about progress and blockers.

Required Skills

  • Currently enrolled at a university, ideally in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Practical experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and some familiarity with Node.js and React/Next.js. Personal projects, coursework, internships, and open-source contributions all count.
  • Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including how to structure and query data.
  • Familiarity with Git, APIs, debugging, and basic testing.
  • Interest in how systems fit together and a willingness to think through dependencies and trade-offs.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining your approach and documenting your work.
  • Initiative and follow-through: you can make progress on a defined task, use feedback, and ask for support when you need it.

Nice to Have

  • Some experience with Python, Rust, or Ruby.
  • Familiarity with caching, Redis, or event-driven systems such as Kafka.
  • First experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, or Cloudflare, especially Workers, Durable Objects, or KV.
  • Exposure to Docker, GitHub Actions, or infrastructure as code.
  • Experience with AI tools, evals, reusable components, internal tools, or project templates.
  • Experience writing short technical specs or documenting design decisions.

These are useful starting points. You’ll have opportunities to learn them on the job.

  • Cloud / Edge: GCP, Azure, or AWS; we particularly like Cloudflare—Workers, Durable Objects, KV, R2, and more.
  • Infra / Tooling: Docker, GitHub Actions, IaC with Terraform.

Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Paid time off aligned with your working schedule, plus applicable public holidays.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.&nbsp;</span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold:&nbsp;</p> <ol> <li><strong>Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency</strong>: we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.</li> <li><strong>Drive strategic engineering initiatives</strong>: architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web.&nbsp;</li> </ol> <p>You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.</p> <p>You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you will</strong></h2> <p><strong>Strategically:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace.</strong> We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job</li> <li><strong>Drive Technology Strategy:</strong> Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Refine the domain's identity: </strong>Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tactically</strong>:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead frontends:</strong> Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead Initiatives:</strong> Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.</li> <li><strong>Elevate global UI quality:</strong> Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.</li> <li><strong>Ensure Resilience &amp; Reliability:</strong> Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.</li> <li><strong>Innovate &amp; Optimize:</strong> Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority</strong>: Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.</p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <p><strong>How much of a technical acumen? </strong>Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.</p> <p><strong>Leadership: </strong>you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Consolidating your team views and making coherent strategy out of those views is step one. Step two is even more important: being able to implement these changes in your domain, and more so - across other domains in the marketplace - is a foundational ability you carry. In practice, that means you have at least 2 years of experience leading leaders and 5 years of experience influencing without authority.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Change horizon:</strong> You are comfortable holding two timeframes at once. We need someone who can say, "Here is what our frontend setup should look like in two years, and here is why" AND name the clear deliverable that has to ship in the first quarter to make that end state reachable. Leaders who only do the second are common. Leaders who only do the first are entertaining. We need both.</p> <p><strong>What this role is not:</strong> This is not a hands-on frontend or release-engineering role. You will not be tuning CI, owning the release train, or reviewing architecture decisions yourself — you’ll have 4 strong EMs and 3 Staff Engineers close to the details, and your job is to turn their technical judgment into direction, alignment, and organizational change. If your strongest work is deep in the mechanics, you'll be underused here. If your strongest work is changing how 40+ teams operate, you'll be busy.</p> <h2><strong>Work perks&nbsp; </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>A daily lunch allowance</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>A subsidised gym membership with ClassPass or Urban Sports Club</li> <li>A subsidised pension plan provided by Vinted</li> <li>Hallesche Supplemental health insurance</li> <li>Life and disability insurance provided</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket</li> <li>The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>Individual Learning Budget</strong></p> <p>We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid Work</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€124.300</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€168.100 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams.

  • Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.

title: Informatikpraktikum E-Commerce im Verlag () (Front/Backend)
description: Wir sind ein erfolgreicher Fachbuch- und Hörmedienverlag im Bereich Alternativ-Medizin mit Sitz in Berlin. Unser Firmensitz (Büro) und Ihr Praktikumsplatz befinden sich in mitten Berlin, zentral gelegen im Bezirk Friedrichshain, der bei jungen Menschen sehr beliebt ist. Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind ganz in der Nähe, somit ist unser Büro leicht zu erreichen. Möglich bei uns sind 3- bis 6-monatige Pflichtpraktika. Freiwillige Praktika sind aufgrund der engen gesetzlichen Bestimmungen nur ausbildungsbegleitende denkbar, sofern noch keine abgeschlossene Ausbildung vorhanden ist. Bei unserem Praktikum können Sie - je nach Ihren Befähigungen und Neigungen - bei der Entwicklung ein neuen Shopsystems als Entwickler mitwirken. Somit bringen Sie Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen nicht nur - wie bei vielen großen Firmen - in ein kleinteilig fraktioniertes Projekt ein, sondern können umfassend eigenständig tätig werden, mit großem gestalterischen und kreativen Freiraum. Meist sind bei uns noch 2-3 weitere Praktikant*innen aktiv, so dass Sie Teil eines kleinen netten Praktikantenteams sind, das sich auch gegenseitig unterstützen kann. Ausländische Bewerber sind willkommen. Foreign applicants are very welcome. German language is NOT necessarily required. Tasks Tätigkeiten, Herausforderungen & Aufgaben während Ihres Praktikums: Migration eines bestehenden SHOPWARE 5.7x Webshops (E-Commerce) auf die jüngste Version der neuen SHOPWARE Architektur 6.x Verwendete Sprachen/Datenbanken: PHP, MySQL, XML, HTML, CSS, JS, Twig Dieses Praktikum gibt Ihnen einen vollständigen Einblick in einen modernen Webshop und die zugrunde liegende Software-Architektur und bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, auf allen Ebenen (Backend und/oder Frontend) kreativ tätig zu sein. Sie können sich an der Migration unseres SHOPWARE-Webshops beteiligen, eigene Module entwickeln und bestehende modifizieren. Nach einer Einarbeitungs-, Trainings- und Nachschulungsphase (wo nötig) können Sie selbst kreativ und eigenständig produktive Beiträge leisten: Entwicklung eigener Plugins bzw. Erweiterungen ("Extensions") sowie Modifizierung bzw. Übertragung vorhandener Extensions in funktionaler Anpassung an die heutige Shopware-6.x-Architektur Freie Entwicklung weiterer nützlicher zukünftiger Funktionalitäten (zusätzliche Features, unabhängige Plugins) Testen von Plugins, die auf dem Markt (Community) verfügbar sind Bei Interesse ist auch die Neugestaltung von Frontend-Themes (Frontend) möglich Optimierung von Anpassungen auf anderen Geräten (Reaktionsfähigkeit, Verbesserung der Skalierbarkeit) Modifizierung und/oder Neugestaltung von Frontend-Themes (bei Interesse an Webdesign) Konzeption von Schnittstellen zwischen interner Verlagssoftware und Webshop Optional besteht bei Bedarf Ihrerseits bei uns die Möglichkeit, ein Projekt bei uns als Ihre Studien/Ausbildungs-Facharbeit (z. B. Bachelorarbeit, Masterarbeit o. ä.) zu realisieren. Requirements ALLGEMEINE VORAUSSETZUNGEN Sie haben ein freundliches Auftreten und eine positive Lebenseinstellung, sind ehrlich, offen und kontaktfreudig Sie arbeiten eigenständig, sorgfältig, engagiert, selbstständig, überlegt und strukturiert und können Eigeninitiative entwickeln Sie sind in der Lage, sich in die Erfordernisse eines komplementärmedizinischen Verlags hineinzudenken und haben Lust, sich in diesem Bereich zu betätigen. SPEZIELLE VORAUSSETZUNGEN FÜR DIESES PRAKTIKUM: Einschlägiges Studium mit IT/ E-Commerce-Affinität, idealerweise eines IT-nahen Faches wie Informatik, Medieninformatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik und/oder Aus- oder eigene Weiterbildung als Webdesigner, Systembetreuer oder Programmierer. Solide Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in PHP, MySQL, JS, XML, HTML, CSS. Sie haben bereits komplexere Projekte absolviert, die PHP und JS beinhalten und können diese auch nachweisen (bitte über den Bewerben-Button einreichen). Sicherheit im Umgang mit MySQL Datenbanken Erfahrungen in der Frontend- und Backend-Webprogrammierung Grundkenntnisse in gängigen Ecommerce-Architekturen wie Shopware oder XT-Commerce wären zusätzlich von Vorteil, sind aber keine Vorbedingung. Benefits Sie können umfassend eigenständig tätig werden, mit großem gestalterischen und kreativen Freiraum. Und Sie lernen das Shopware-System auf allen Ebenen (Frontend, Backend, Developer) umfassend kennen. Sie bekommen Ihre eigenen Testserver als Übungs- und Entwicklungsfläche und können sich dort frei betätigen. Bei Abschluss des Praktikums erhalten Sie ein detailliertes, qualifiziertes Praktikumszeugnis, das sich als Sprungbrett in größere E-Commerce-Firmen bzw. IT-Agenturen erwiesen hat. Bei entsprechendem Einsatz können Sie durch das Praktikum zu einem Shopware-Experten werden, da Sie bei uns das gesamte Webshop-System kennenlernen und nicht nur einen kleinen Ausschnitt. Vergütung: Als kleiner Betrieb können wir in der Regel (insbesondere bei noch geringen Programmierkenntnissen) keine Praktikumsvergütung leisten. raw.description:
The essentials

Team: Product & Engineering

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office

Working language: English (German: a plus)

Salary band: Shared before your first interview

Your impact

As (Senior) Backend Engineer at Gymondo, you build and improve the scalable backend systems that power our platform for hundreds of thousands of active users. You work with a modern tech stack, establish new services using clean architecture principles, and help translate legacy concepts into maintainable, future-proof code. Your work directly shapes the technical foundation that enables Gymondo to grow — reliably, efficiently and at scale.

What you’ll drive

  • You build, improve and maintain scalable backend services using Golang and Gin-Gonic, following clean architecture and established design patterns

  • You design and implement REST APIs following OpenAPI standards, with a focus on clarity, reliability and long-term maintainability

  • You contribute to our microservice architecture — working on reliability, scaling, stateless applications and event-driven systems

  • You rebuild legacy concepts and translate them into well-known programming patterns with transparent and maintainable business logic

  • You develop data-driven features and are involved in all stages of the development process — from design to deployment

  • You work on our scalable, automated infrastructure using AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform

  • You participate in peer code reviews, write unit tests and champion agile development practices

  • You share knowledge, discuss better solutions openly and grow together with the team

What defines you

Must-have

  • 4+ years of professional experience in backend-focused development, including infrastructure

  • 3+ years contributing to microservice architectures with a focus on reliability, scaling, stateless applications, event-driven systems and clean architecture

  • 3+ years designing REST APIs following OpenAPI standards

  • Proven hands-on experience with Golang and Gin-Gonic

  • Ability to design proof of concepts and prototypes

  • Standardised coding practices: peer code reviews, unit testing and a preference for agile development

  • An open mindset and genuine interest in state-of-the-art technologies and methodologies

  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with JVM languages (Kotlin / Java) and frameworks such as Ktor, Spring or Node.js

  • A Product Engineer mindset: balancing technical excellence with business impact, proactively identifying trade-offs that prioritise user value and speed-to-market without compromising long-term system health

  • Strong communication skills across the Product & Engineering team and additional stakeholders

  • A collaborative, humble approach — you promote good relationships in your guild and are always willing to learn from others

Our tech stack

Golang, Kotlin, Node.js, Java 17 · Gin-Gonic, Ktor, NestJS, Spring Boot · Elasticsearch, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis · Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes · Event-Driven Architecture · AWS

Benefits

Success requires positive energy. That's why we ensure the right conditions are in place — physically, mentally, and within the team:

  • 🏖️ 30 days of vacation per year + Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve as additional paid days off

  • 🏠 Hybrid working model — 60% in the office, 40% from home, applicable to all working hours

  • 🌍 Up to 4 weeks of work from abroad per year (Berlin-based roles)

  • 🏋️ Free Urban Sports Club M membership & access to Nilo Health for mental health and personal development

  • 📱 Free access to 7Mind, Gymondo & Buddyfit — our own digital wellbeing products

  • 🚲 €30 monthly mobility budget via Navit

  • 📚 €1,000 annual training budget + a wide range of opportunities for personal growth and development

  • 👨👩👧 Family-friendly benefits — childcare costs & paid sick days for children

  • 🍎 The office classics — fruit & vegetable basket, muesli & yogurt (also vegan), drinks & snacks

  • 🐶 Pet-friendly office — four-legged colleagues are very welcome!

These benefits apply to full-time and part-time permanent employees. Working students and interns receive a pro-rated selection.

People who make things happen

Gymondo is one of the leading digital fitness and nutrition platforms in the DACH region — with over 2,000 workouts, holistic training programmes and smart nutrition plans. As part of 7NXT Health Group, we help millions of people make movement a lasting part of their everyday lives.

Our team pushes each other, thinks critically and grows together. We take responsibility — for our users, our products and our planet.

Everyone counts

We welcome what makes you unique.

At Gymondo we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here.

Don’t meet all the criteria? No problem — if you’d like to help shape the future of fitness & wellbeing with us, we look forward to your application.

Need a more accessible process or have questions? Write to us — we’ll find a way.

GENUINE gehört zu den führenden TikTok-Shop-Agenturen Deutschlands. Wir unterstützen Marken dabei, durch Creator-getriebenen E-Commerce, kreativen Content und datenbasierte Strategien nachhaltig zu wachsen. Für unser wachsendes CAP Team (Creator Acquisition & Production) suchen wir einen kreativen, kommunikationsstarken und TikTok-begeisterten Creator Acquisition & Content Manager (m/w/d) . Du verbringst gerne Zeit auf TikTok, erkennst Trends, bevor sie viral gehen, und weißt, was guten Content ausmacht? Du liebst es, mit Menschen zusammenzuarbeiten, kreative Ideen zu entwickeln und Videos zu produzieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Creatorn und Influencern auf und pflegst diese aktiv. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team eine lebendige und engagierte Creator Community rund um GENUINE und unsere Partnermarken. Du organisierst Creator Meetups, Networking-Events, Content Days und weitere Community-Aktivitäten. Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Creator und unterstützt sie bei ihrer Weiterentwicklung. TikTok Trends & Content Strategie Du beobachtest aktuelle TikTok-Trends, virale Challenges, neue Creator und innovative Content-Formate. Du recherchierst und analysierst erfolgreiche TikTok-Videos und identifizierst die Faktoren, die sie besonders erfolgreich machen. Du erkennst virale Hooks, Storytelling-Techniken und kreative Ansätze, die Reichweite, Engagement und Conversions steigern. Du entwickelst aus Trends und Performance-Daten kreative Content-Ideen, Konzepte und überzeugende Videoskripte. Du konzipierst innovative Content-Formate, die auf unterschiedliche Marken, Produkte und Zielgruppen zugeschnitten sind. Content Creation & Videoproduktion Du planst, organisierst und koordinierst Videodrehs mit unseren TikTok Creatorn. Du produzierst gemeinsam mit Creatorn authentischen, unterhaltsamen und verkaufsstarken TikTok-Content. Du schreibst kreative Skripte, entwickelst spannende Storylines und überzeugende Hooks. Du begleitest Creator durch den gesamten Produktionsprozess – von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Video. Du experimentierst mit unterschiedlichen Videoformaten, Storytelling-Techniken und kreativen Ansätzen. Du stellst sicher, dass der produzierte Content sowohl zu unseren Markenpartnern als auch zur TikTok-Plattform passt. Performance Analyse & Optimierung Du analysierst die Performance unserer Videos anhand relevanter KPIs wie Views, Engagement, Conversion Rate und GMV. Du erkennst erfolgreiche Content-Muster und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du gibst unseren Creatorn konstruktives Feedback und hilfst ihnen dabei, ihre Inhalte kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Growth-, Shop-Management- und Creator-Management-Teams zusammen, um die Performance unserer Inhalte zu maximieren. Your profile Ausgeprägte TikTok-Affinität: Du bist auf TikTok zu Hause, verfolgst aktiv Trends und verstehst die Plattform, ihre Kultur, Algorithmen und Content-Formate. Du hast ein natürliches Gespür dafür, welche Videos Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen und viral gehen können. Du bist ein echter TikTok Native: Du konsumierst Content nicht einfach nur, sondern verstehst, warum bestimmte Videos funktionieren, erkennst neue Trends frühzeitig und kannst Inspirationen in kreative Ideen verwandeln. Kreativität: Du liebst es, neue Content-Ideen zu entwickeln, Skripte zu schreiben und innovative Videoformate auszuprobieren. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist offen, kontaktfreudig und hast Spaß daran, neue Menschen kennenzulernen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen. Leidenschaft für die Creator Economy: Du verstehst die Creator-Szene und erkennst schnell, welche Talente Potenzial haben. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst gerne selbst mit an, organisierst Drehs und setzt kreative Ideen gemeinsam mit Creatorn in die Praxis um. Analytisches Denken: Du hast Spaß daran, Video-Performance zu analysieren und aus Daten neue kreative Ansätze abzuleiten. Eigeninitiative & Organisation: Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl. Erste Erfahrungen im Influencer Marketing, Creator Management, Social Media oder in der Content-Produktion sind von Vorteil. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Why us? Das bieten wir dir Die Möglichkeit, eine der am schnellsten wachsenden TikTok Creator Communities Deutschlands aktiv mitzugestalten. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit spannenden Marken, kreativen Talenten und erfahrenen E-Commerce-Experten. Ein kreatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Ideen schnell Realität werden können. Viel Eigenverantwortung und die Freiheit, neue Content-Formate auszuprobieren. Ein junges, ambitioniertes und internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien. Ein modernes Office mit Möglichkeiten zur Content-Produktion mitten in Köln. Attraktive Benefits wie Urban Sports Club und einen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket. Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in der schnell wachsenden Welt des Social Commerce. Bereit, die Zukunft des Social Commerce mitzugestalten? Bei GENUINE betreuen wir nicht einfach nur Creator – wir bauen eine Community auf, die die Zukunft des Social Commerce aktiv mitgestaltet. Wenn TikTok deine Welt ist, Kreativität zu deinen Stärken gehört und du gerne mit Menschen zusammenarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen! Werde Teil von GENUINE und hilf uns dabei, kreative Talente, erfolgreichen Content und echte Verkaufserfolge miteinander zu verbinden. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Keine Woche sieht aus wie die andere. Das ist kein Bug, sondern der Grund, warum man hier schnell lernt. Qualifikationen Was Du mitbringen musst Laufendes Studium, mindestens zwölf Monate verfügbar. Was zählt, ist, ob Du Dich schnell in Fremdes einarbeitest, nicht, was auf dem Zeugnis steht. Programmierkenntnisse. Prototypen bauen wir mit modernen AI-Tools und ohne Programmierung. Wie das geht, lernst Du bei uns. Beratungs- oder Startup-Erfahrung. Ein fertiges KI-Projekt im Portfolio. Uns interessiert, wie Du denkst, nicht was Du schon gebaut hast. Wir schauen auf die Lernkurve, nicht auf den Startpunkt. Du passt zu uns, wenn Du Dich in den letzten zwei Wochen über Deinen eigenen schlechten Output geärgert und ihn dann besser gemacht hast. Du in 30 Minuten ein Memo schreibst, das eine Geschäftsführerin in fünf Minuten gelesen und verstanden hat. Du bei einem neuen Thema nicht fragst "wo fange ich an", sondern schon angefangen hast. Du dem Gründer widersprichst, wenn Du ein Argument hast, und Deine Meinung änderst, wenn er das bessere hat. Dein letzter Studi-Job Dich entweder gelangweilt oder Dir gezeigt hat, was Du wirklich willst. Du ehrliches Feedback persönlich nimmst, statt es in der nächsten Version umzusetzen. Bei uns wird jeder Entwurf kommentiert, auch die des Gründers. Marek war Mitgründer von Flightright, bis zum Exit. Sein Netzwerk zu deutschen Gründerteams und Tech-Firmen gibt es dazu. Tooling ohne Budgetdiskussion. Zugang zu Claude, OpenAI, Cursor und allem, was wir selbst nutzen. Studienverträglich. Klausurenphase heißt weniger Stunden, Semesterferien gern mehr. 22 Euro pro Stunde. Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss Unsere Kultur: Ownership statt Micromanagement. Lieber in zwei Wochen eine smarte Wette machen und daraus lernen, als drei Monate etwas polieren, das niemand validiert hat. Wir suchen Leute, die mitdenken, nicht nur mitarbeiten, und das gilt für Werkstudierende genauso wie für alle anderen. Deshalb behandeln wir Werkstudierende als Talent-Pipeline, nicht als günstige Arbeitskraft. Du bekommst echte Verantwortung bei echten Kunden, nicht die Aufgaben, die sonst niemand machen will. Wer bei uns überzeugt, hat nach dem Studium drei realistische Wege: Festanstellung als Consultant oder Product Builder, eine Empfehlung in unser Netzwerk aus Gründerteams, Top-Beratungen und deutschen Tech-Scaleups, oder die eigene Gründung mit Sparring und gegebenenfalls Angel-Investment aus dem Gründernetzwerk. So bewirbst Du Dich. Schick uns zwei Dinge: Deinen Lebenslauf. Ein Beispiel in höchstens zwei Absätzen: eine Aufgabe, bei der Du mit KI zu einem besseren Ergebnis gekommen bist, als Du es allein geschafft hättest. Dazu den anonymisierten Prompt, was beim ersten Versuch nicht funktioniert hat, was Du daraufhin geändert hast und wie Du geprüft hast, ob das Ergebnis wirklich gut war. Gut zu uns passen Leute aus BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Maschinenbau, Jura, Psychologie, Kognitionswissenschaft, Politik oder Philosophie. Was zählt, ist, ob Du Dich schnell in Fremdes einarbeitest, nicht, was auf dem Zeugnis steht.

  • Programmierkenntnisse. Prototypen bauen wir mit modernen AI-Tools und ohne Programmierung. Wie das geht, lernst Du bei uns.

  • Beratungs- oder Startup-Erfahrung.

  • Ein fertiges KI-Projekt im Portfolio. Uns interessiert, wie Du denkst, nicht was Du schon gebaut hast.

Wir schauen auf die Lernkurve, nicht auf den Startpunkt.

Du passt zu uns, wenn

  • Du Dich in den letzten zwei Wochen über Deinen eigenen schlechten Output geärgert und ihn dann besser gemacht hast.

  • Du in 30 Minuten ein Memo schreibst, das eine Geschäftsführerin in fünf Minuten gelesen und verstanden hat.

  • Du bei einem neuen Thema nicht fragst "wo fange ich an", sondern schon angefangen hast.

  • Dir jemand sagt "die Folie überzeugt nicht", und Deine erste Frage ist "was fehlt?", nicht "warum?".

  • Du dem Gründer widersprichst, wenn Du ein Argument hast, und Deine Meinung änderst, wenn er das bessere hat.

  • Dein letzter Studi-Job Dich entweder gelangweilt oder Dir gezeigt hat, was Du wirklich willst.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für Dich, wenn

  • Du auf eine klar strukturierte Aufgabenliste wartest, statt selbst zu priorisieren.

  • Du ehrliches Feedback persönlich nimmst, statt es in der nächsten Version umzusetzen. Bei uns wird jeder Entwurf kommentiert, auch die des Gründers.

  • Du bei Kundenpräsentationen lieber Vorlagen ausfüllst, als Inhalte zu hinterfragen.

  • Du planbare Wochen brauchst, um gut zu arbeiten.

  • Du KI-Ergebnisse ungeprüft weitergeben würdest.

  • Du vor allem einen bekannten Namen im Lebenslauf suchst. Den hast Du bei einer großen Beratung schneller.

  • Du neben dem Studium noch nichts außerhalb der Uni verantwortet hast. Dann ist ein Praktikum der bessere nächste Schritt.

Benefits

  • AI-native werden. Du baust den Skill auf, den gerade jede Beratung und jedes Unternehmen sucht, und wendest ihn jede Woche bei echten Kunden an, nicht im Seminarraum.

  • Direkter Impact. Kein Layer zwischen Dir und den Entscheidern: der Gründer bei uns, die Geschäftsführung beim Kunden. Was Du vorschlägst, wird umgesetzt oder verworfen, nicht archiviert.

  • Mit Innovation wachsen. Neue Tools landen bei uns nicht in einer Roadmap, sondern in derselben Woche in einem echten Projekt. Wer etwas gefunden hat, das funktioniert, zeigt es.

  • Ein Gründer, der es schon einmal gemacht hat. Marek war Mitgründer von Flightright, bis zum Exit. Sein Netzwerk zu deutschen Gründerteams und Tech-Firmen gibt es dazu.

  • Tooling ohne Budgetdiskussion. Zugang zu Claude, OpenAI, Cursor und allem, was wir selbst nutzen.

  • Studienverträglich. Klausurenphase heißt weniger Stunden, Semesterferien gern mehr.

  • 22 Euro pro Stunde.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Unsere Kultur: Ownership statt Micromanagement. Lieber in zwei Wochen eine smarte Wette machen und daraus lernen, als drei Monate etwas polieren, das niemand validiert hat. Wir suchen Leute, die mitdenken, nicht nur mitarbeiten, und das gilt für Werkstudierende genauso wie für alle anderen.

Deshalb behandeln wir Werkstudierende als Talent-Pipeline, nicht als günstige Arbeitskraft. Du bekommst echte Verantwortung bei echten Kunden, nicht die Aufgaben, die sonst niemand machen will. Wer bei uns überzeugt, hat nach dem Studium drei realistische Wege: Festanstellung als Consultant oder Product Builder, eine Empfehlung in unser Netzwerk aus Gründerteams, Top-Beratungen und deutschen Tech-Scaleups, oder die eigene Gründung mit Sparring und gegebenenfalls Angel-Investment aus dem Gründernetzwerk.

So bewirbst Du Dich.

Dazu den anonymisierten Prompt, was beim ersten Versuch nicht funktioniert hat, was Du daraufhin geändert hast und wie Du geprüft hast, ob das Ergebnis wirklich gut war.

  3. Einen Satz: das Ergebnis neben dem Studium, auf das Du am stolzesten bist, und was ohne Dich daran gefehlt hätte.

Der zweite und dritte Teil sind uns wichtiger als der Lebenslauf. Kein Anschreiben nötig.

title: (Senior) AI Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Du brennst für KI und willst sie in einem ganzen Unternehmen zum Leben erwecken? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen einen (Senior) AI Specialist (m/w/d) mit echtem KI-Mindset: Ideengeber, Sparringspartner und Antreiber, der KI bei uns in der Entwicklung und im gesamten Unternehmen voranbringt. Wir sind ein junges Tech-Unternehmen und entwickeln eine innovative Softwarelösung für die Logistik. Unser Ziel: Mehrweglösungen so einfach wie Einweg machen und damit einen der nervigsten Prozesse der Branche optimieren – während wir gleichzeitig den CO₂-Fußabdruck der Logistik deutlich reduzieren. In dieser Rolle schaust du über den Tellerrand: Du erkennst, was wir mit unseren vorhandenen Daten alles möglich machen können, und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns die KI-Strategie von Loopario – für unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und unsere tägliche Arbeit als Team. Dabei musst du die KI-Features nicht selbst programmieren, sondern gibst die Richtung vor und zeigst, wie KI sinnvoll eingesetzt wird. Aufgaben Ideengeber für KI: Du bringst proaktiv neue Ideen ein, wo und wie wir KI bei Loopario sinnvoll nutzen können – im Produkt, in der Organisation und in unseren Workflows. Blick auf unsere Daten: Du analysierst die bei uns vorhandenen Daten und entwickelst Ideen, was sich damit alles umsetzen lässt und wie KI dabei echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schafft. KI-Strategie mitgestalten: Du entwickelst die gesamte KI-Strategie von Loopario mit, baust sie kontinuierlich aus und behältst dabei Nutzen, Kosten und Machbarkeit im Blick. Sparringspartner fürs Unternehmen: Du stehst allen Teams – von Sales über Customer Success bis Product – bei KI-Themen mit Rat und Tat zur Seite und hilfst, aus Ideen konkrete Lösungen zu machen. KI in der Entwicklung: Du unterstützt unsere Entwicklungsabteilung dabei vorhandene KI-Tools weiterzuentwickeln und optimierst die entsprechenden Prozesse und Workflows. Schulungen & Enablement: Du behältst die rasante Entwicklung im KI-Bereich im Blick und schulst die unterschiedlichen Teams im Unternehmen zu KI-Themen und –Nutzung. Dabei befähigst du alle Kolleg:innen, KI im Arbeitsalltag selbstbewusst einzusetzen. Prototyping: Du baust schnell eigene KI-Tools und Prototypen, um Ideen zu testen, und entscheidest gemeinsam mit dem Team, was daraus weiterverfolgt wird. Qualifikation KI-Mindset: Du hast Bock auf KI, brennst für die schnellen Entwicklungen in diesem Bereich und willst dich und deine Arbeitsweise ständig weiterentwickeln. Claude-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits intensiv mit Claude gearbeitet und kennst seine Möglichkeiten aus der Praxis. Trendkenntnis: Du kennst die aktuellen KI-Trends und Tools und kannst einordnen, was davon Hype ist und was echten Mehrwert bringt. Praxiserfahrung: Du hast bereits eigene, coole Tools mit KI gebaut und kannst uns zeigen, was du damit erreicht hast. Programmierkenntnisse: Du bringst Programmierkenntnisse als solide Grundlage mit, um technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und eigene Prototypen umzusetzen (C# von Vorteil. Datenverständnis: Du denkst in Daten und hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wie sich vorhandene Daten für den Einsatz von KI nutzen und aufbereiten lassen. Kommunikation & Vermittlung: Du erklärst komplexe KI-Themen verständlich, begeisterst auch nicht-technische Kolleg:innen und gibst dein Wissen gerne in Schulungen weiter. Hierzu verfügst du über fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und gute Englischkenntnisse. Was du nicht brauchst: Du musst keine KI-Modelle selbst programmiert oder trainiert haben – uns kommt es auf die sinnvolle Anwendung von KI an. Benefits Dein Buden-Buddy, unsere Welcome-Box sowie eine strukturierte Einführungsphase helfen dir dich schnell bei uns zurechtzufinden und bei uns anzukommen Du erlebst eine positive Teamkultur durch regelmäßige Buden-Spieleabende, wöchentliche Coffee Dates, gemeinsame sportliche Aktivitäten (Firmenläufe, …), spannende Sommerevents, u.v.m. Bei der Wahl deines Arbeitsstandorts sind wir flexibel und du entscheidest, ob du ins Büro kommen möchtest oder von Zuhause aus arbeiten möchtest Wir wollen gemeinsam „groß“ werden und freuen uns, wenn du Teil der Reise bist und aktiv an der Entwicklung der Bude mitwirkst Deine Arbeit hat einen nachhaltigen Impact, denn wir verkleinern den CO2-Fußabdruck der Logistik Wähle die Incentives, die zu dir passen: Wir bezuschussen das Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass und das Jobrad Betriebliche Altersvorsorge 30 Urlaubstage Sollte selbstverständlich sein, haben wir aber auch: Kostenlose Getränke, Auswahl deiner Arbeitsgeräte, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Our Culture More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. raw.title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
raw.description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

  • Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
  • Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
  • Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
  • Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
  • Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
  • Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
  • Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
  • Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
  • Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
  • Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

  • Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning
  • No active backlogs
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
  • Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects
  • Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking
  • A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

title: Senior Consumer Duty Specialist
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role In this role, you will play a central part in assessing, questioning, and enhancing how customers experience Pleo. Drawing on deep regulatory knowledge, you will lead Consumer Duty initiatives, actively spot potential customer harm, examine what drives customer journeys, and ensure targeted remediation creates lasting, positive impact. You'll need sharp analytical skills and the confidence to influence stakeholders, translating data and MI into decisive action. You will construct and manage dashboards and reporting mechanisms that illuminate emerging patterns, vulnerable customer risks, and key concerns, offering executive leadership clear visibility into operational gaps and necessary solutions. Your contribution goes well beyond producing MI. You will conduct QA across complex complaint handling and sensitive customer interactions, manage Ombudsman cases, and speak up when evidence shows outcomes aren't meeting expectations. Collaborating across teams, you'll turn data-driven insights into practical improvements, drive projects to completion, and evaluate whether changes deliver real results for our users. We're seeking someone who views Consumer Duty as a powerful driver of business improvement rather than a routine compliance exercise. You'll bring together technical understanding, rigorous analysis, and constructive challenge to investigate root causes, align key partners, deliver change, and prove that customer experiences are continuously getting better. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You'll work closely with teams across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, Technology, and other business functions. The role will have broad exposure across the organisation, particularly when customer outcome risks or Consumer Duty-related remediation require cross-functional action. You'll also work closely with senior stakeholders through Consumer Duty governance and reporting, helping translate detailed analysis into clear insights, risks, recommendations, and actions. What you’ll be doing As a Consumer Duty Specialist, you will: Turn data into customer outcome insight : Build and own MI, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that give the business a clear view of customer outcomes, trends, risks, and emerging areas of concern. Own Consumer Duty reporting : Produce monthly and quarterly Consumer Duty reporting, turning complex data into a clear story for senior leadership and Board-level audiences. You'll go beyond showing what happened to explain why it matters and what we should do about it . Identify customer harm : Use complaints, QA findings, customer feedback, vulnerable customer data, Ombudsman cases, and MI to identify potential customer harm, emerging risks, and systemic issues. Challenge the business : Where the evidence suggests customers aren't receiving good outcomes, you'll be expected to ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the issue is properly understood and addressed. Drive remediation and change : Work with stakeholders across the business to agree remediation plans, establish clear owners and timelines, and help drive Consumer Duty-related projects and improvements through to completion. Provide complaints QA : Conduct weekly quality reviews of complaints handled by the Complaints Manager, using findings to identify quality issues, customer risks, and wider trends. Manage Ombudsman activity : Act as the primary operational contact with the UK Ombudsman, managing referred complaints, responses, remedies, compensation, invoices, and related communications. Leverage AI and smart automation : Spot opportunities to apply automated tools and AI to scale and streamline Consumer Duty analytics, monitoring, and workflows. You will feel empowered to test emerging tech and eliminate repetitive manual work, maintaining proper critical evaluation and human governance whenever compliance risks or customer impacts are involved. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Strong Consumer Duty knowledge : You understand the principles of Consumer Duty and how they translate into practical customer outcomes, particularly across complaints, customer support, vulnerable customers, and customer journeys. Strong data and MI experience : You know how to take complex data, build meaningful dashboards and reporting, and identify the insights that actually matter. You're comfortable working with data rather than simply consuming reports created by others. A customer outcome mindset : You're naturally curious about how customers are experiencing the business and are able to connect data, customer feedback, complaints, and operational activity to real customer outcomes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills : You can spot trends, anomalies, and patterns, investigate root causes, and determine whether an issue is isolated or potentially systemic. The confidence to challenge : You're comfortable questioning decisions, processes, and assumptions when the evidence suggests customers may be experiencing poor outcomes. You can challenge constructively and build relationships at the same time. A bias towards action : You don't believe reporting is the end of the process. You want to understand what needs to change, bring people together, and help make it happen. Project and remediation experience : You're comfortable managing actions, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and risks across cross-functional projects, particularly where there is a regulatory, customer, or operational outcome to deliver. An AI and automation mindset : You're naturally curious about how AI and automation can make processes more efficient, improve analysis, and free up time for higher-value work. You look for sensible opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and use AI to augment your thinking, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, critical judgement, and accountability — particularly where customer outcomes or regulatory decisions are involved. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You love using data to uncover things that others might not see. You want your analysis to drive real change, rather than sit in a report or dashboard. You enjoy asking "why?" and getting to the root cause of customer problems. You're comfortable challenging the business when the evidence tells you something isn't working. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer to produce reporting without being involved in what happens afterwards. You're uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or having difficult conversations when customer outcomes aren't where they should be. You prefer working within a narrow functional remit rather than across multiple teams. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll: Build a deep understanding of our customer outcome data, existing Consumer Duty MI, complaints, vulnerable customer journeys, and current areas of risk. Take ownership of key Consumer Duty dashboards and reporting, developing a clear view of the metrics and insights that matter most. Establish strong relationships with stakeholders across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology. Lead the analysis behind Consumer Duty reporting and help shape how customer outcomes are presented to senior stakeholders and the Board. Over time, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Pleo measures, understands, and improves customer outcomes, helping move Consumer Duty from a regulatory obligation into a genuine driver of better customer experiences and better business decisions. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Meet the Hiring Manager: 1hr going through role in more depth. Pleo Challenge: A case study were you talk us through how you'd solve a work appropriate challenge. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we advertised this role, we received a really high volume of applications but could only select so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. raw.title: Senior Consumer Duty Specialist
raw.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

In this role, you will play a central part in assessing, questioning, and enhancing how customers experience Pleo. Drawing on deep regulatory knowledge, you will lead Consumer Duty initiatives, actively spot potential customer harm, examine what drives customer journeys, and ensure targeted remediation creates lasting, positive impact.

You'll need sharp analytical skills and the confidence to influence stakeholders, translating data and MI into decisive action. You will construct and manage dashboards and reporting mechanisms that illuminate emerging patterns, vulnerable customer risks, and key concerns, offering executive leadership clear visibility into operational gaps and necessary solutions.

Your contribution goes well beyond producing MI. You will conduct QA across complex complaint handling and sensitive customer interactions, manage Ombudsman cases, and speak up when evidence shows outcomes aren't meeting expectations. Collaborating across teams, you'll turn data-driven insights into practical improvements, drive projects to completion, and evaluate whether changes deliver real results for our users.

We're seeking someone who views Consumer Duty as a powerful driver of business improvement rather than a routine compliance exercise. You'll bring together technical understanding, rigorous analysis, and constructive challenge to investigate root causes, align key partners, deliver change, and prove that customer experiences are continuously getting better.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll work closely with teams across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, Technology, and other business functions.

The role will have broad exposure across the organisation, particularly when customer outcome risks or Consumer Duty-related remediation require cross-functional action.

You'll also work closely with senior stakeholders through Consumer Duty governance and reporting, helping translate detailed analysis into clear insights, risks, recommendations, and actions.

What you’ll be doing

As a Consumer Duty Specialist, you will:

  • Turn data into customer outcome insight: Build and own MI, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that give the business a clear view of customer outcomes, trends, risks, and emerging areas of concern.

  • Own Consumer Duty reporting: Produce monthly and quarterly Consumer Duty reporting, turning complex data into a clear story for senior leadership and Board-level audiences. You'll go beyond showing what happened to explain why it matters and what we should do about it.

  • Identify customer harm: Use complaints, QA findings, customer feedback, vulnerable customer data, Ombudsman cases, and MI to identify potential customer harm, emerging risks, and systemic issues.

  • Challenge the business: Where the evidence suggests customers aren't receiving good outcomes, you'll be expected to ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the issue is properly understood and addressed.

  • Drive remediation and change: Work with stakeholders across the business to agree remediation plans, establish clear owners and timelines, and help drive Consumer Duty-related projects and improvements through to completion.

  • Provide complaints QA: Conduct weekly quality reviews of complaints handled by the Complaints Manager, using findings to identify quality issues, customer risks, and wider trends.

  • Manage Ombudsman activity: Act as the primary operational contact with the UK Ombudsman, managing referred complaints, responses, remedies, compensation, invoices, and related communications.

  • Leverage AI and smart automation: Spot opportunities to apply automated tools and AI to scale and streamline Consumer Duty analytics, monitoring, and workflows. You will feel empowered to test emerging tech and eliminate repetitive manual work, maintaining proper critical evaluation and human governance whenever compliance risks or customer impacts are involved.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong Consumer Duty knowledge: You understand the principles of Consumer Duty and how they translate into practical customer outcomes, particularly across complaints, customer support, vulnerable customers, and customer journeys.

  • Strong data and MI experience: You know how to take complex data, build meaningful dashboards and reporting, and identify the insights that actually matter. You're comfortable working with data rather than simply consuming reports created by others.

  • A customer outcome mindset: You're naturally curious about how customers are experiencing the business and are able to connect data, customer feedback, complaints, and operational activity to real customer outcomes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: You can spot trends, anomalies, and patterns, investigate root causes, and determine whether an issue is isolated or potentially systemic.

  • The confidence to challenge: You're comfortable questioning decisions, processes, and assumptions when the evidence suggests customers may be experiencing poor outcomes. You can challenge constructively and build relationships at the same time.

  • A bias towards action: You don't believe reporting is the end of the process. You want to understand what needs to change, bring people together, and help make it happen.

  • Project and remediation experience: You're comfortable managing actions, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and risks across cross-functional projects, particularly where there is a regulatory, customer, or operational outcome to deliver.

  • An AI and automation mindset: You're naturally curious about how AI and automation can make processes more efficient, improve analysis, and free up time for higher-value work. You look for sensible opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and use AI to augment your thinking, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, critical judgement, and accountability — particularly where customer outcomes or regulatory decisions are involved.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love using data to uncover things that others might not see.

  • You want your analysis to drive real change, rather than sit in a report or dashboard.

  • You enjoy asking "why?" and getting to the root cause of customer problems.

  • You're comfortable challenging the business when the evidence tells you something isn't working.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer to produce reporting without being involved in what happens afterwards.

  • You're uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or having difficult conversations when customer outcomes aren't where they should be.

  • You prefer working within a narrow functional remit rather than across multiple teams.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Build a deep understanding of our customer outcome data, existing Consumer Duty MI, complaints, vulnerable customer journeys, and current areas of risk.

  • Take ownership of key Consumer Duty dashboards and reporting, developing a clear view of the metrics and insights that matter most.

  • Establish strong relationships with stakeholders across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology.

  • Lead the analysis behind Consumer Duty reporting and help shape how customer outcomes are presented to senior stakeholders and the Board.

Over time, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Pleo measures, understands, and improves customer outcomes, helping move Consumer Duty from a regulatory obligation into a genuine driver of better customer experiences and better business decisions.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Meet the Hiring Manager: 1hr going through role in more depth.

  3. Pleo Challenge: A case study were you talk us through how you'd solve a work appropriate challenge.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we advertised this role, we received a really high volume of applications but could only select so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Building an understanding of the backend systems and APIs that power our app. Monitoring released features and helping to resolve issues when they arise.
